commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo STAGE=USB_PREFLIGHT
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
echo USB_EXACT_S22=true
STATE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
[[ "$STATE" == 0 ]] || { echo PHONE_IDLE=false; exit 1; }
echo PHONE_IDLE=true
ROLE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"
case "$ROLE" in
pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab) echo DIALER_ROLE=LAB ;;
pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge) echo DIALER_ROLE=PRODUCTION ;;
*) echo DIALER_ROLE=OTHER_OR_UNKNOWN ;;
esac
for pkg in pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab; do
  if [[ "$pkg" == *.s8lab ]]; then label=LAB; else label=PRODUCTION; fi
  if [[ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$pkg" 2>/dev/null || true)" == package:* ]]; then
    echo "${label}_INSTALLED=true"
    result="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell content call --uri "content://$pkg.gsmbinder" --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "$result" == *host_registered=true* ]]; then
      echo "${label}_HOST_READY=true"
    else
      echo "${label}_HOST_READY=false"
    fi
  else
    echo "${label}_INSTALLED=false"
  fi
done
if [[ "$ROLE" == pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab ]]; then
  echo STAGE=LAB_HOST_RESTORE
  ANDROID_SERIAL="$SERIAL" bash scripts/bin/start-s8-gsm-shell.sh --start
  echo LAB_HOST_RESTORED=true
else
  echo LAB_HOST_RESTORE_SKIPPED_ROLE_NOT_LAB=true
fi
echo NO_CALLS_NO_INSTALL=true
commands.output:
STAGE=USB_PREFLIGHT
USB_EXACT_S22=true
PHONE_IDLE=true
DIALER_ROLE=PRODUCTION
PRODUCTION_INSTALLED=true
PRODUCTION_HOST_READY=false
LAB_INSTALLED=false
LAB_HOST_RESTORE_SKIPPED_ROLE_NOT_LAB=true
NO_CALLS_NO_INSTALL=true
